data.text: Good, I can see the structure. Now let me run a query to calculate total revenue per seller state (region), filtering out canceled and unavailable orders.

args.purpose: Calculate total revenue by seller state (region), excluding canceled/unavailable orders
args.sql:
SELECT 
    s.seller_state,
    SUM(oi.price) as total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY s.seller_state
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
